verdict.rationale: Rippling's own pages say dynamic rules handle account provisioning and group access, so the right people get the right access as roles change (docs-3). They also say groups, access and permissions update automatically when roles change or people leave (docs-18, docs-1). Together this covers the core of rule-driven membership replacing one-by-one grants. missing for 10: in-depth docs on rule criteria and how dynamic group membership is configured, explicit documentation of group-to-app assignment mechanics, independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing copy.
